source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: Typed school paper with a real text layer (checked against the page images). History/Civics only; the paper has no Geography section, so no geography pack was built from it. No year is printed on the paper; examYear 2022 is taken from the file name (...-200922-2022) and the icseboard.org folder. No marks are printed for any group or item (only M.M: 35), so every item is recorded with marks 0 and flagged LOW; the listed marks total is therefore 0. Numbering restarts in each group, so the group numeral (I-XII) is stored as the question number and the item number as the part. 'Any two' groups (VIII, IX, XI) share a choiceGroup. The paper's own spellings (e.g. 'Ganary', 'Grihasta') are kept. The icseboard.org watermark and the WhatsApp/Paytm advertisement on page 3 are ignored.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
